system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Enrolls the farmer in PMFBY crop insurance for a specific crop and land parcel for the current season. For your information, my area_hectares is dummy_area_hectares_1683, my land_parcel_id is dummy_land_parcel_id_4020, my sowing_date is dummy_sowing_date_3639, my crop_type is dummy_crop_type_4438, my aadhaar_number is 100020003617.

function.name: pmfby_enroll_policy
function.description: Enrolls the farmer in PMFBY crop insurance for a specific crop and land parcel for the current season. Transitions policy_status from 'not_enrolled' to 'enrolled'. Requires session_token. Enrollment must be within the season window. This tool does NOT calculate or collect premium — use pmfby_calculate_premium and pmfby_pay_premium. Fails if: enrollment window has closed, farmer is ineligible, crop-land mapping is invalid, or a duplicate enrollment exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

land_parcel_id.description: Unique identifier of the land parcel to be insured.

sowing_date.description: Expected sowing date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
